meta.name: west4-friday
meta.what: The one Friday every screen, staging and end-to-end test uses: West 4 Boho Karaoke, Fri Sep 25, 2026, 10:41 PM. Source: docs/archive/fix-brief-sep28.md section 3 and 4.5. The narrative is docs/demo-seed.md.

conventions.times: ISO 8601 with the -04:00 offset (EDT). Sat Sep 26 times after midnight belong to business date 2026-09-25.
conventions.ids: Stable slugs. The loader maps each to a UUID and keeps the slug as an external id.
conventions.nulls: null means the brief does not say. Nothing is invented to fill it.
conventions.phones: Fictional 555-01xx numbers. Seven come from the Staff canvas; the ones marked phone_made_up were made up for this seed.
conventions.check_numbers: Only Room 9's check is fixed (#1042). The loader numbers the others from the venue counter; no test may depend on them.
conventions.room_codes: Only Room 9's code is fixed (KX4M7). The loader generates the rest.
conventions.derived: Numbers under expected_at_now, if_presented_now and expected_* are computed with docs/spec/05-money-rules.md and match fix brief 3a and 4.5. seed/money-cases.json holds the same numbers as test vectors.

meta.demo_pin_warning: DEMO ONLY. The PINs in `team` are the fix brief's demo PINs for the staging seed and the design canvas. Never load them into production, where each person chooses their own.
meta.demo_sign_in_warning: DEMO ONLY (M1-19). `demo_email` and `demo_totp_secret` on the owner and the manager let local dev and staging sign in by email plus an authenticator app; the addresses are placeholders on a .local domain, not real ones. Real addresses and passkeys are set by each person. Never load these into production.
flags: Room 3 is a 3–6 room (small tier). Fix brief 3b calls Manage's demo booking 'Room 3 (medium tier)'. This seed uses small.
Room-ready text has two wordings (fix brief 3i #4: 'You have 10 minutes to claim it at the front desk.'; 4.3: 'Come to the front desk within 10 minutes.'). Pick one before build.
The Rail canvas lists 119 items and Admin → Menu 127 lines. The 8 spirit bottles only Admin lists are added here as in_rail_canvas false.

Maya's $12 of reason-only use is only a running total in the brief (reason_only_used_tonight). No comp line backs it. Spec 02 and 04 total a person's comps and voids from their lines over the open shift, so before a test asserts '$63 left this shift', seed a $12.00 comp line for Maya or write the total as a shift counter.
o4's void ($36.00) is over the $25 reason-only limit. The spec does not say whether the bar's choice after a return (Void · not made, Void · made, Remake) counts against the limit.
The brief fixes the five bar tabs' names, cards and states. Their lines and holds (Tariq A.'s $100, for one) come from the Rail canvas.
Room 7's ID count is not in the brief (null).
Drawer opening times and per-drawer cash are not in the brief (null). The starting bank is spec 03's $300.
Most check numbers, most room codes and the whole night's Z totals are not in the brief and are not seeded (see conventions). Only #1042 and KX4M7 are fixed.
The brief has no phone numbers. 10 guests and all 7 singers have made-up numbers (phone_made_up: true); the other 7 guests' numbers come from the Staff canvas. All are fictional 555-01xx numbers.

scenarios.expect: o2 shows Asked to wait, stays under Waiting for you and keeps aging; the badge stays at 2; no screen offers Ready or Delivered until Accept. Room 5's phone reads "The bar needs a few minutes".
Room 5's tab so far $40.00 → $72.00 (first-hour minimum $40.00 + $32.00). The room's ID chip reads ID ✓ 4 of 4.
